title: Code actions: framework and unknown-opcode quick fix
description: Advertise codeActionProvider with quickfix kind, resolve actions from diagnostics in the request range. First action: 'Did you mean X' for unknown opcodes, ranked by edit distance against the opcode table.
notes: Acceptance: covered by .clif fixtures with check: lines via the fixture harness; no unit tests.

title: Code actions: fix undefined names
description: Quick fixes for undefined value/block/entity diagnostics: suggest the nearest defined name, and offer to insert a stub block or declaration.
notes: Acceptance: covered by .clif fixtures with check: lines via the fixture harness; no unit tests.

title: Epic: editing assistance
description: Code actions, signature help, inlay hints, folding, document highlight and call hierarchy on top of the existing parser, resolver and tables.

title: Syntax diagnostics
description: Map parser error nodes to publishDiagnostics; snapshot against broken/ fixtures.
notes: Acceptance: covered by .clif fixtures with CHECK lines via the fixture harness; no unit tests.

title: tower-lsp-server skeleton + document store
description: initialize/shutdown, didOpen/didChange/didClose with ropey, UTF-16 position conversion, reparse on change.

title: Generate opcode table from cranelift-codegen-meta 0.136.2
description: xtask/example reads cranelift-codegen-meta shared instructions: opcode name, operand kinds, results, docs, format. Output checked-in src/tables/opcodes.rs.

title: Lexer
description: Tokens with spans: idents, vN, blockN, %names, numbers (hex/float/sci), strings, punctuation. Comments (including '; CHECK:', '; RUN:', '; run:' directive lines) are kept as comment tokens/trivia and never interpreted. Covered by a 'tokens' harness mode + CHECK fixtures.

title: Syntax tree and tolerant parser
description: Test directives, functions (signature, entity decls sig/fn/ss/gv/const, blocks with params, instructions). FileCheck/run directive lines stay comment nodes. Recovery: skip to next line on bad instruction, to next 'function'/brace on bad structure; emit error nodes, never abort. Covered by 'syntax-tree' fixtures with CHECK lines incl. broken/.

title: FileCheck fixture harness (tests/fixtures.rs)
description: Done: tests/fixtures.rs (harness=false) walks tests/fixtures/**/*.clif; '; mode: a, b' selects modes; output '=== mode ===' + rendering is checked with the filecheck crate's native directives (check:, nextln:, sameln:, not:, unordered:, regex:). Caret annotations ('; ^ kind args') parsed into queries for position modes. Only mode so far: 'source' (echo minus directive lines). Optional name filter arg: cargo test --test fixtures <substr>.

title: Vendor fixtures from ../clif2wasm into tests/fixtures
description: Copy the 216 .clif files from ../clif2wasm/tests/fixtures into tests/fixtures/valid/ (keep '; run:' / '; entry:' lines as comments). Record source commit in tests/fixtures/README. Add hand-written tests/fixtures/broken/: missing brace, truncated instruction, unknown opcode, undefined v/block refs, half-typed 'v1 = iad'. CHECK lines are added by the beads that implement each feature.

title: Epic: opcode and type tables (cranelift 0.136.2)
description: Opcode/type/condcode/immediate tables sourced from cranelift 0.136.2, checked in as generated Rust, no heavy runtime dep.

title: Epic: lexer and tolerant parser
description: Lossless, error-recovering CLIF lexer/parser producing a span-carrying syntax tree. Never fail on broken input; recover per line / per brace.

title: Epic: test corpus and harness
description: Fixtures, snapshot (insta) infra, and checks every other epic relies on.

title: Formatting: document and range
description: Implement textDocument/formatting and rangeFormatting. Canonical style: 4-space instruction indent, blocks at function-body indent, one space after commas, consistent block header and param spacing, comments preserved, blank-line normalization. Must be tolerant: format whatever parses and leave broken regions untouched. Output must be idempotent. Depends on the parser fixes for braces sharing a line.
notes: Acceptance: covered by .clif fixtures with check: lines via the fixture harness; no unit tests.

title: Control flow graph
description: Build per-function CFG from branch/jump/br_table/brif targets. Expose a custom request returning the graph (dot and JSON) and flag unreachable blocks as a diagnostic with the Unnecessary tag.
notes: Acceptance: covered by .clif fixtures with check: lines via the fixture harness; no unit tests.

title: Call hierarchy
description: prepareCallHierarchy, incomingCalls, outgoingCalls for %functions from call/return_call/call_indirect sites in the file.
notes: Acceptance: covered by .clif fixtures with check: lines via the fixture harness; no unit tests.

title: Result type inference
description: Infer the type of every value (explicit .type suffix, block params, and opcode constraints such as icmp results) by running cranelift-reader and mapping Value types back to source spans. Also fills the hover gap for values without a suffix.
notes: Acceptance: covered by .clif fixtures with check: lines via the fixture harness; no unit tests.

title: Inlay hints
description: textDocument/inlayHint: inferred result types after instructions and block parameter hints for calls. Respect the requested range.
notes: Acceptance: covered by .clif fixtures with check: lines via the fixture harness; no unit tests.

title: Folding and selection ranges
description: foldingRange for functions, blocks and comment runs; selectionRange expanding token, instruction, block, function.
notes: Acceptance: covered by .clif fixtures with check: lines via the fixture harness; no unit tests.

title: Document highlight
description: textDocument/documentHighlight for every definition and use of the symbol under the cursor, reusing navigation::occurrences.
notes: Acceptance: covered by .clif fixtures with check: lines via the fixture harness; no unit tests.

title: Code actions: unused declarations and missing terminator
description: Remove an unused sigN/fnN/ssN/gvN declaration; insert a 'return' or 'trap' when the verifier reports a block without a terminator.
notes: Acceptance: covered by .clif fixtures with check: lines via the fixture harness; no unit tests.

title: Signature help
description: textDocument/signatureHelp: show the opcode signature from the table with the active operand highlighted, including calls to %functions defined in the file. Trigger on space and comma.
notes: Acceptance: covered by .clif fixtures with check: lines via the fixture harness; no unit tests.

title: Epic: analysis and pipeline views
description: Control flow graph, dominance and liveness info, and views of a function after Cranelift pipeline stages.

title: Go-to-definition, references, rename
description: Values, blocks, sigN/fnN/ssN/gvN, function names.
notes: Acceptance: covered by .clif fixtures with CHECK lines via the fixture harness; no unit tests.

title: Semantic diagnostics via cranelift-reader + verifier
description: When parse is clean, run reader + verifier and map errors to source ranges; undefined-name warnings from our resolver otherwise.
notes: Acceptance: covered by .clif fixtures with CHECK lines via the fixture harness; no unit tests.

title: Document symbols
description: Functions, blocks, entity decls.
notes: Acceptance: covered by .clif fixtures with CHECK lines via the fixture harness; no unit tests.

title: Harness LSP client (duplex) for fixture modes
description: In-process tower-lsp-server client over tokio duplex streams used by the fixture harness LSP modes; renders responses as stable text for CHECK lines.
notes: Acceptance: covered by .clif fixtures with CHECK lines via the fixture harness; no unit tests.

title: Drift test vs cranelift_codegen::ir::Opcode
description: Dev-dep cranelift-codegen =0.136.2. Implemented as an always-on harness invariant (no unit test): generated opcode names == ir::Opcode set, failing the fixture run on mismatch.

title: Types, condition codes, immediates tables
description: Value types (i8..i128, f16..f128, vectors), IntCC/FloatCC names, trap codes, MemFlags. Same generation path.

title: Name resolution pass
description: Resolve value/block/entity defs and uses per function; tolerate duplicates and undefined names.

title: Built-in oracle: cranelift-reader agreement
description: Harness invariant on fixtures not under broken/ and not marked '; XFAIL-ORACLE': cranelift_reader::parse_functions succeeds iff we emit zero syntax errors, and function/block/inst counts match.

title: Built-in invariants run on every fixture
description: Not a separate test: the harness applies these to every fixture automatically. (1) no panic; (2) spans in bounds and on char boundaries; (3) lossless: reprinted tree == input; (4) truncation sweep: re-parse every line-prefix and every byte-prefix (char boundaries) of the file and re-check 1-3. Deterministic, no proptest.

title: Epic: LSP server skeleton
description: tower-lsp-server binary, document store (ropey), full sync, lifecycle, stdio, integration test client.

title: Epic: diagnostics
description: Syntax diagnostics from our parser; authoritative semantic diagnostics from cranelift-reader + verifier when parse is clean.

title: Epic: symbols, navigation, hover, completion
description: Document symbols, goto-def/references/rename, hover, completion, semantic tokens.

title: Optimization pass views
description: Extend the custom stage request with per-pass snapshots (e.g. after egraph, simple_gvn, licm, dce) and a unified diff between two chosen stages, rendered as a read-only virtual document. Needs a design pass on which passes are exposed and how Context is driven pass by pass.
notes: Acceptance: covered by .clif fixtures with check: lines via the fixture harness; no unit tests.

title: Machine code and disassembly view
description: Add a stage that emits final machine code for the target ISA and shows disassembly with per-instruction offsets, ideally mapped back to CLIF instructions via source locs. Needs a design pass on the disassembler (cranelift disas feature / capstone vs. shelling out to objdump) and how it fits the existing vcode stage in src/stages.rs.
notes: Acceptance: covered by .clif fixtures with check: lines via the fixture harness; no unit tests.

title: Code actions: structural refactors
description: Add refactor code actions: add missing block params for used-but-undefined values, collapse brif with identical targets into jump, extract repeated iconst into a shared value, wrap trailing instructions in a new block. Each needs a precondition check so it only appears when valid.
notes: Acceptance: covered by .clif fixtures with check: lines via the fixture harness; no unit tests.

title: Epic: formatting, refactors, and codegen views
description: Second wave of features: canonical formatting, richer code actions, per-pass optimization views, and machine code disassembly.

title: Parser rejects a function whose braces share a line
description: 'function %g() { }' is accepted by cranelift-reader but the line-based parser reports unclosed function body and unexpected braces. Found by the oracle check while writing ranges fixtures.

title: Pipeline stage views
description: Custom request that returns a function after a chosen Cranelift stage (verified, legalized, optimized/egraph, lowered to a target ISA) as a read-only virtual document. Needs a design pass on which stages and settings are exposed.
notes: Acceptance: covered by .clif fixtures with check: lines via the fixture harness; no unit tests.

title: Dominance and liveness info
description: Dominator tree and per-value live ranges over the CFG. Surface through hover (dominating block, live range) and a custom request.
notes: Acceptance: covered by .clif fixtures with check: lines via the fixture harness; no unit tests.

title: Reader errors can land on the line after the real problem
description: cranelift-reader reports the line of the lookahead token, so errors like a missing operand surface on the following line. Find a way to attribute them to the offending instruction, with a diagnostics fixture covering it.

title: Semantic tokens
description: Opcode, type, value, block, entity, comment, number.
notes: Acceptance: covered by .clif fixtures with CHECK lines via the fixture harness; no unit tests.

title: Hover
description: Value type + defining instruction; opcode docs from table; signature for calls.
notes: Acceptance: covered by .clif fixtures with CHECK lines via the fixture harness; no unit tests.

title: Completion
description: Opcodes after '=', types after '.', condcodes, in-scope values/blocks.
notes: Acceptance: covered by .clif fixtures with CHECK lines via the fixture harness; no unit tests.
